model.title: Worked example: Bloom Valley (incremental) - for learning, not tuning

semantics.hard_walls: every gated buyable or enemy: from affordable (or beatable) while locked until it unlocks; an activity only while the policy pursues it

omitted: steps after the first first_steps_kept other than resets, goals, soft walls and spikes
metric history between segment starts, spikes and the last value

never_claims: a population forecast (one policy is one strategy)
any default threshold, rate, horizon or session length

behaviour: policy greedy-roi: one modelled strategy, not the player population
assumptions.note: every result below is conditional on all listed inputs and the behaviour lines; the tool does not trace which result uses which input
